title: Non-null context is object, string or array
description: Where the document carries an @context at its root, the value is null, a string naming an external context, a context object, or an array of those.
summary: A non-null `@context` is an object, a string, or an array of objects and strings

errorMessage.type: every member of an @context array is null, a string, or a context object
an @context is null, a string, a context object, or an array of those
